evidence.title: Admin Dashboard Template with Next.js & Shadcn UI

name: next-shadcn-dashboard-starter
summary: MIT-licensed Next.js admin dashboard starter with working data tables, forms, Clerk auth, organizations and billing.
description: A production-ready admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS v4 and TypeScript. Tables search, filter, sort and paginate through TanStack Table with React Query and nuqs; forms validate with TanStack Form and Zod; Clerk provides authentication, multi-tenant organizations, billing and plan gating. A cleanup script strips whichever features you do not need.
contains: Next.js 16 admin dashboard starter, MIT licensed
pages: dashboard overview, product and user tables, kanban, chat, AI chat, notifications, workspaces, billing, profile
data tables with search, filter, sort and pagination (TanStack Table + React Query + nuqs)
forms with TanStack Form and Zod plus create/update mutations
Clerk auth, organizations, billing and plan-based access control
sidebar layout with six-plus themes and a theme switcher
cleanup script removes optional features in a minute
ships AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and a Claude Code skill
